proves.claim: An item whose coordinator check is unticked is submitted in a scratch repo without the builder running pullboard check.

cli.journeys-submit-frozen-check.submits.why: Without it, submit could stop reaching the frozen check step and every builder would again have to call check --yes before submitting.

proves.claim: A red frozen check refuses the submit naming the check and its first failing lines, and a check with no recorded author is not run.

cli.io-commands-submit.red-or-legacy-che.why: Without it a red check could submit, or a legacy check could run without its author's confirmation.

proves.claim: Submit runs the frozen check once when a test clause waits on it, with no confirmation prompt.

cli.io-commands-submit.runs-frozen-check.why: Without it builders keep calling pullboard check by hand before every submit.
